description: This file defines the 'JmsConnectionFactory' interface responsible for creating JMS connections within the Eclipse Ditto project, specifically for the AMQP messaging implementation. It declares a method to instantiate JMS connections with associated configurations and logging.

classes.name: JmsConnectionFactory
classes.description: Interface for creating JMS Connection instances configured with specific connection and logging parameters.

methods.name: createConnection
methods.description: Creates a new JMS Connection using the provided Connection object, exception listener, and connection logger. Throws JMSException or NamingException on failure.
